observations: Viewed the original cloud PNGs from EL7 and Ubuntu 24.04. The configuration view selector, all five rows and the bottom limitation text fit and are readable.
The displayed row order is target 0 A, target 0 B, local C, target 1 A, target 1 B, with stored values 0.75, 0.875, 1, 1.125, 1.25. Four target labels say averaged; the local mirror does not.
Every row states Unverified in the Unit column and Configuration mirror; unit unverified in Status. The scaled-clock column contains a dash, not a guessed frequency or voltage.

Raw words and offsets 0x40c, 0x414, 0x434, 0x410, 0x418 are visible. Capture metadata shows table 0x00620205 with 2452 captured/expected bytes. Firmware targets are not labeled as physical CCDs or OS CPUs.
The footer identifies the 98.84.0 reference and separate sparse command remap, with physical CCD/OS association and capture provenance unverified.
These are offline synthetic snapshots. The disabled native-reader control retains its default Shimada selection; it does not identify the loaded capture or demonstrate a native hardware read.
